author: Cleo Abram
description:
In space, there’s low pressure, radiation, and extreme temperatures! Tardigrades use some insanely clever tricks to stay alive, what would happen if we used them too?
 
In 2007, scientists opened a container of 3,000 tardigrades in space….and most came back ALIVE. And right now… there are LIVE TARDIGRADES… on THE MOON! 

To know why subscribe!

#moon #space #survive #tardigrade #human
title: How Tardigrades Survive in SPACE
